nodes.description: Immutable reference to the VaultParameters contract used by every Auth modifier for permission checks; assigned once in the constructor.
Sets vaultParameters from the constructor argument; no validation of _parameters.
Modifier that calls vaultParameters.isManager(msg.sender) and reverts when the caller is not a manager.
Modifier that calls vaultParameters.canModifyVault(msg.sender) to gate Vault-modifying entry points.
Modifier that calls vaultParameters.vault() and compares it with msg.sender.
Address of the VaultParameters contract passed to the Auth constructor; written directly into the vaultParameters state variable without a zero-address check.
Attacker-controlled caller address used in the isManager, canModifyVault and vault comparisons of the Auth modifiers.
Mapping token => yearly stability fee, only writable by managers.
Mapping token => liquidation fee percentage, bounded to <= 100 on write.
Mapping token => USDP mint limit, only writable by managers.
Permission mapping consumed by the hasVaultAccess modifier.
Privileged role mapping consumed by the onlyManager modifier; deployer is granted the role in the constructor.
Nested mapping oracleType => asset => enabled flag, only writable by managers.
Address payable of the Vault contract compared against msg.sender by onlyVault.
Foundation address, only writable by managers and validated against address(0).
Initialises the protocol: validates _vault/_foundation, grants isManager to msg.sender and stores vault/foundation.
Grants or revokes manager status for an arbitrary address; guarded by onlyManager.
Changes the foundation address after a zero-address check; guarded by onlyManager.
Convenience function that configures fee, limit and oracle types for a collateral in one manager-only call.
Grants or revokes canModifyVault permission; guarded by onlyManager.
Writes the stability fee for an asset with no upper bound; guarded by onlyManager.
Writes the liquidation fee for an asset, requiring newValue <= 100; guarded by onlyManager.
Enables/disables an oracle type for an asset; guarded by onlyManager.
Writes the USDP debt limit for an asset; guarded by onlyManager.
Pre-computed Vault address, checked against address(0) and stored in the vault state variable.
Foundation address checked against address(0) and stored in the foundation state variable.
Target address whose manager flag is set; fully attacker-chosen when the caller is a manager.
Boolean flag written into isManager[who].
New foundation address validated against address(0) and written to storage.
Collateral token address forwarded to setStabilityFee, setLiquidationFee, setTokenDebtLimit and setOracleType.
Stability fee value forwarded to setStabilityFee (3 decimals, unbounded).
Liquidation fee value forwarded to setLiquidationFee (bounded to 100 there).
USDP mint limit forwarded to setTokenDebtLimit.
Calldata array of oracle type ids iterated in the loop and enabled for the asset.
Address receiving or losing the canModifyVault permission.
Boolean written into canModifyVault[who].
Token address used as the key of the stabilityFee mapping write.
New stability fee value stored without any range validation.
Token address used as the key of the liquidationFee mapping write.
New liquidation fee value, required to be <= 100.
Oracle type id used as the first key of the isOracleTypeEnabled mapping.
Collateral address used as the second key of the isOracleTypeEnabled mapping.
Enable/disable flag written into isOracleTypeEnabled[_type][asset].
Token address used as the key of the tokenDebtLimit mapping write.
New USDP debt limit stored without validation.
Unchecked uint loop counter (i++) in Solidity 0.7 bounded only by oracles.length.
Caller address granted isManager rights in the constructor and checked by the inherited onlyManager modifier on every setter.
External call vaultParameters.isManager(msg.sender) executed by onlyManager before the guarded function body mutates state.
External call vaultParameters.canModifyVault(msg.sender) executed by the hasVaultAccess modifier.
External call vaultParameters.vault() executed by the onlyVault modifier to authorise the caller.
Mapping token => oracle address written by setOracle.
Mapping oracle type id => oracle address written by setOracle.
Validates the parameters address against address(0) and forwards it to the Auth constructor.
Registers an oracle for an asset/type pair after an argument check; guarded by onlyManager.
VaultParameters address validated as non-zero and passed to Auth.
Collateral address used as the key of oracleByAsset, required to be non-zero.
Oracle address written to both oracleByAsset and oracleByType without a zero-address check.
Oracle type id used as the key of oracleByType, required to be non-zero.
Caller address validated by the inherited onlyManager modifier before setOracle writes oracle configuration.

edges.reason: Constructor argument _parameters is written into the vaultParameters state variable with no zero-address or code check, so all later permission checks depend on this unvalidated address.
Auth constructor assigns the vaultParameters state variable.
Constructor argument _vault is consumed by the VaultParameters constructor.
Constructor argument _foundation is consumed by the VaultParameters constructor.
Validated _vault is stored into the vault state variable used by onlyVault.
Validated _foundation is stored into the foundation state variable.
Deployer (msg.sender) is unconditionally written into isManager, granting full administrative privilege.
Constructor writes isManager[msg.sender] = true.
Attacker-supplied who address is the key of the privilege mapping written by setManager.
permit flag controls whether manager rights are granted or revoked.
who is used as the key of the isManager mapping.
permit is the value stored in isManager for the target address.
newFoundation is the argument consumed by setFoundation.
Manager-controlled address is written into the foundation state variable, replacing the trusted foundation.
asset parameter drives the whole setCollateral fan-out.
stabilityFeeValue parameter of setCollateral.
liquidationFeeValue parameter of setCollateral.
usdpLimit parameter of setCollateral.
oracles array parameter of setCollateral.
Collateral asset becomes the key of the stabilityFee write performed from setCollateral.
Collateral asset becomes the key of the liquidationFee write performed from setCollateral.
Collateral asset becomes the key of the tokenDebtLimit write performed from setCollateral.
stabilityFeeValue is forwarded to setStabilityFee and stored in stabilityFee[asset].
liquidationFeeValue is forwarded to setLiquidationFee and stored in liquidationFee[asset].
usdpLimit is forwarded to setTokenDebtLimit and stored in tokenDebtLimit[asset].
Each element of the oracles array is enabled for the asset in isOracleTypeEnabled.
who parameter is consumed by setVaultAccess.
permit parameter of setVaultAccess.
Attacker-supplied who becomes the key of the canModifyVault permission mapping.
permit is the boolean stored in canModifyVault, granting Vault-modification rights.
asset parameter consumed by setStabilityFee.
newValue parameter consumed by setStabilityFee.
asset becomes the key of the stabilityFee mapping write.
Unbounded manager-controlled fee value is written directly to stabilityFee[asset] without a range check.
asset parameter consumed by setLiquidationFee.
newValue parameter consumed by setLiquidationFee.
asset becomes the key of the liquidationFee mapping write.
newValue is bounded by require(newValue <= 100) before being written to liquidationFee[asset].
_type parameter consumed by setOracleType.
asset parameter consumed by setOracleType.
enabled parameter consumed by setOracleType.
_type is the outer key of the isOracleTypeEnabled mapping write.
asset is the inner key of the isOracleTypeEnabled mapping write.
enabled is the value stored in isOracleTypeEnabled[_type][asset].
asset parameter consumed by setTokenDebtLimit.
limit parameter consumed by setTokenDebtLimit.
asset becomes the key of the tokenDebtLimit mapping write.
Arbitrary limit value is written to tokenDebtLimit[asset] without any bound.
oracles.length bounds the loop counter i.
Loop index i selects oracles[i], whose value is forwarded to setOracleType.
setCollateral internally calls setStabilityFee.
setCollateral internally calls setLiquidationFee.
setCollateral internally calls setTokenDebtLimit.
setCollateral calls setOracleType inside the oracles loop.
Unchecked uint loop counter i++ in Solidity 0.7 iterating over a calldata array of arbitrary length.
setManager is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setFoundation is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setCollateral is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setVaultAccess is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setStabilityFee is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setLiquidationFee is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setOracleType is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
setTokenDebtLimit is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
OracleRegistry.setOracle is guarded by the inherited onlyManager modifier.
onlyManager performs the external isManager lookup that decides whether execution continues.
hasVaultAccess performs the external canModifyVault lookup.
onlyVault performs the external vault() lookup and compares it to msg.sender.
vaultParameters state variable is the target of the isManager external call.
vaultParameters state variable is the target of the canModifyVault external call.
vaultParameters state variable is the target of the vault() external call.
msg.sender is passed as the argument of the isManager external authorization call.
msg.sender is passed as the argument of the canModifyVault external authorization call.
msg.sender is compared against the value returned by the external vault() call.
VaultParameters callers are authorised through the isManager mapping lookup with msg.sender.
OracleRegistry callers are authorised through the same isManager lookup with msg.sender.
VaultParameters constructor invokes the Auth constructor with address(this).
OracleRegistry constructor invokes the Auth constructor with the supplied parameters address.
vaultParameters constructor argument is consumed and validated by OracleRegistry.constructor.

The external isManager call executes while the guarded body of setManager has not yet written isManager[who]; a malicious or upgraded parameters contract could re-enter the privilege-management entry points during this callback.
asset key of the oracleByAsset mapping write in setOracle.
Arbitrary oracle address is written into oracleByAsset[asset] without a zero-address or code check.
The same oracle address overwrites oracleByType[oracleType], so one type can only map to one oracle.
oracleType key of the oracleByType mapping write in setOracle.
setOracle performs the oracleByAsset state write.
setOracle performs the oracleByType state write.
